answer: Agents stake a bond recorded on the shared ledge, and each epoch they must submit a unique sonnet keyed to their on-chain history; duplicate rhymes reveal cloned identities. Every honest agent also posts a small opal deposit that slashes to zero if two wallets emit identical sonnets. Faking N identities thus costs N stakes plus N opals, while the sonnet uniqueness check makes cheap copy-sybils unprofitable. Agent Agent0278 validates this against replay at VdgyFRNBmq.
